training_method.objective_quote: The responses with the highest and lowest rewards are then annotated as online preference pairs, which are used to train the base model with the DPO objective.

source_claims.quote: It's a fine-tuned meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model trained using preference learning on the PsyCoPref dataset.
We use Llama3.2-3B-Instruct and Llama3.1-8B-Instruct as the base models.

description.text:
This model is presented in the paper Preference Learning Unlocks LLMs' Psycho-Counseling Skills. It's a fine-tuned meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model trained using preference learning on the PsyCoPref dataset. This dataset contains 36k high-quality preference comparison pairs aligned with the preferences of professional psychotherapists.

The model aims to improve the quality of responses in psycho-counseling sessions and achieves a win rate of 87% against GPT-4o.

serving.notes: The card says usage is the same as meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. config.json architecture is LlamaForCausalLM. The chat template is the Llama 3.1 template inside tokenizer_config.json; there is no separate chat_template.jinja. The date lines are the template's built-in system header. No counseling system prompt is set. There is no adapter_config.json.

evaluation_reported.text: Llama3-8B(+DPO-Iter) achieves the best performance, with a high overall win rate of 87.0% against GPT-4o. With a length constraint the same run is 77% against GPT-4o. The card states a win rate of 87% against GPT-4o.

discrepancies: Inventory methods is empty. The paper trains the 87% model with iterative DPO. The parent matches. The card YAML dataset id is Psychotherapy-LLM/PsychoCounsel-Preference. That URL opens the dataset whose Hub id is Psychotherapy-LLM/PsyCoPref (34,329 train and 2,324 test rows). The paper HTML never prints Psychotherapy-LLM/PsyCoPref-Llama3-8B. It names the 87% model PsyCo-Llama3-8B, defined as Llama3-8B (+DPO-Iter). config.json _name_or_path is Psychotherapy-LLM/PsychoCounsel-Llama3-8B. The OpenReview abstract of the same paper names PsychoCounsel-Llama3-8B. The card says this repository is the model in the paper and states the same 87% win rate.
